He's actually here? ! Xia Wan'an stared at Han Jingnian in shock for a few seconds before looking away and looking out the window. The car was parked a little far away from the surrounding street lights. The light inside the car was relatively dark. He was also wearing a black suit. If it weren't for the light emitted by the computer, it would be difficult for anyone to notice that there was a person sitting in the back seat. However... He was a busy man with many things to do. He could just send Zhang Te to help him, so why would he deign to do it himself? After she got in the car, Han Jingnian didn't react much from beginning to end, as if she were air. However, the invisible oppression emanating from him made Xia Wan'an obviously feel that the air in the car had become a little thin. She moved uneasily towards the car door, slightly increasing the distance between herself and him. She didn't know if it was her movements that disturbed him, but she felt his head tilt toward her. His subtle move made Xia Wan'an look at him reflexively. He and she just looked at each other, and her eyes flew around in shock. He was very quiet, as if he had no intention of speaking, but she was a little confused... Should she say hello? But what should she say to say hello? What should I call him? My husband must not be able to shout out. Han Jingnian calls her by his first name too much, and Mr. Han, Mr. Han, seems to be pretentious... Xia Wan'an thought about it for a while, and finally replaced his title with "that": "Um...so you are in the car?" Zhang Teshu, who was going to buy water, heard this sentence when he opened the door and almost laughed out loud. That...which one? Madam is so cute, she actually called Mr. Han... Han Jingnian didn't answer. Xia Wanan An touched his nose with a bit of embarrassment and lowered his head to look at his phone. After seeing this scene in full view, Special Assistant Zhang couldn't help but sigh heavily in his heart. He doesn't like to eat melons, but he likes to eat Mr. Han's melons... He thought he would be able to watch some good shows after he took the initiative to invite his wife in the car, but who knows... If there is no good show, he still has to clean up the mess for Mr. Han... Thinking about it, Special Assistant Zhang spoke and relaxed the atmosphere: "Madam, drink some water." "Thank you." Xia Wan'an gave Assistant Zhang a thankful look and took the water. "Madam, you didn't get hurt anywhere in the fight, did you?" "No." "Madam, why did you fight?" "..." After Xia Wan'an chatted with Special Assistant Zhang for a few words, Assistant Assistant Zhang's cell phone rang. Assistant Zhang said "I'm sorry" and put on his earphones to answer the phone. Through the rearview mirror, Xia Wan'an secretly glanced at Han Jingnian, who was still staring at the computer screen, and then lowered his head to look at the cell phone that had been vibrating in his hand just now. Song Youman created a new WeChat group called "The ruthless pretty boy". There were only three people in it, her, Han Zhijin and Song Youman. (Song Youman): "I'm home. Are you all okay?"
